warnings.descriptionIs: Norðvestan 15-23 m/s og vindhviður staðbundið yfir 35 m/s. Varasamt ferðaveður, einkum fyrir ökutæki sem taka á sig mikinn vind.
warnings.descriptionEn: Northwest gale or strong gale, 15-23 m/s with windgusts locally over 35 m/s. Traveling may become hazardous, especially for vehichles that are sensitive to wind.

warnings.headlineIs: Norðvestan hvassviðri eða stormur austantil á svæðinu
warnings.headlineEn: Northwest gale or strong gale in the east part of the region
warnings.descriptionIs: Norðvestan 15-23 m/s og vindhviður staðbundið yfir 35 m/s, en hægari vindur vestantil á svæðinu. Varasamt ferðaveður, einkum fyrir ökutæki sem taka á sig mikinn vind.
warnings.descriptionEn: Northwest gale or strong gale, 15-23 m/s with windgusts locally over 35 m/s, but slower wind in the west part of the region. Traveling may become hazardous, especially for vehichles that are sensitive to wind.
